### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/service-analytics`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **11** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsResult (symbol, a top-level interface))_
- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsResult (symbol, a top-level interface), AnalyticsResultResponseSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsResult (symbol, a top-level interface))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsResult (symbol, a top-level interface))_
- `content/docs/releases/v9.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsResult (symbol, a top-level interface))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **170** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 739c972735d6feb9d1eea7be5d943cf340486fed` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e9cbbb8b926f68aeabf7ef81c789daae730d0b21` — the merge of head `ba62840b7d742525f60c41a225359ea3887b3a72` into base `739c972735d6feb9d1eea7be5d943cf340486fed`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e9cbbb8b926f68aeabf7ef81c789daae730d0b21 && git checkout e9cbbb8b926f68aeabf7ef81c789daae730d0b21
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 739c972735d6feb9d1eea7be5d943cf340486fed ba62840b7d742525f60c41a225359ea3887b3a72 && git checkout -B drift-repro 739c972735d6feb9d1eea7be5d943cf340486fed && git merge --no-ff ba62840b7d742525f60c41a225359ea3887b3a72

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 739c972735d6feb9d1eea7be5d943cf340486fed
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 739c972735d6feb9d1eea7be5d943cf340486fed` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ba62840b7d742525f60c41a225359ea3887b3a72`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts + packages/spec/src/api/analytics.test.ts (the compile-time schema-equals-contract pin, L50), packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts (`FilterConditionSchema`, L2332-2351; `$null`, L1813), packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json, packages/services/service-analytics/src/drill-scope.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts (L3076, L3088-3125, L3261-3268, L4961-4973, L4847-4863, L4933-4950), packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts (`resolveSelectionTokens`, L128-158; `selection.measures`, L567), packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts (L870, L902-903), packages/services/service-analytics/src/scoped-measure-key.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-filter-field-binding.ts (header), packages/services/service-analytics/src/index.ts (L38-39), packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts (L263-269), ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts (L7303-7314, L7481-7489), docs/adr/0021-analytics-dataset-semantic-layer.md (D2, Consequences), #30080 comment 6631202970, .changeset/30526-dataset-measure-drill-scopes.md, AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 3), scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs (level axis, L907-935, L1605-1606, L2052)

Inputs read: card #30526 body and all five comments (triage 6661303021, claim 6662301380, amendments 6662348690 / 6662348741, os-dev-report 6664363611); PR #30596 body, its 13-file list, and the net diff `f5aaa0bc..ba62840b` (merge-base of the head with `main`; the head is a merge commit whose own first-parent diff touches none of the hits); the check-runs on `ba62840b`. At the last poll: 38 success, 9 skipped, 0 failure, 19 still in progress (five Test Core shards, twelve Test UI shards, Type Check UI, Type Check workspace). Concluded and relevant here: Build Core, Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Type Check source gates and consumer gates, Lint ESLint, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build & E2E UI, all success. No conclusion on this head is a failure. The in-progress ones remain the queue's gate, not this record's.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept-set, wire** — `AnalyticsResultResponseSchema.data` (analytics.zod.ts L254-268) gains an optional `drillScopes: z.record(z.string(), FilterConditionSchema)`. `data` is a plain `z.object`, so before this head a served `drillScopes` was stripped on parse and after it it survives; every payload that parsed before still parses. A pure widening. **Right.** The refusals pinned in analytics.test.ts (a string scope, a list in an equality slot, `$and` given an object, an array map) are `FilterConditionSchema`'s own and the record shape's; none narrows anything that parsed before.
2. **Public surface, contract** — `AnalyticsResult.drillScopes`, an optional `Record` of measure name to `FilterCondition` (analytics-service.ts L339) on `@objectstack/spec/contracts`. Optional member; every existing implementer and reader compiles unchanged. The compile-time pin `AnalyticsResultMatchesContract` (an `Assert` of `Eq` between `AnalyticsResultResponse['data']` and `AnalyticsResult`, analytics.test.ts L50) forces the schema and the contract to move together, and both moved. **Right.**
3. **Published JSON Schema** — `api/AnalyticsResultResponse` gains `data.drillScopes` with `additionalProperties` = the `FilterCondition` projection minus its comparand `superRefine` (filter.zod.ts L2351), which `z.toJSONSchema` cannot emit. That is the one new ledger site, `data.drillScopes.valueType.lazy`; header totals 251 to 252 schemas and 1019 to 1020 sites match one new schema block carrying one site. **Right** (judged in ③ as the dev's open question).
4. **`content/docs/references/api/analytics.mdx`** — one generated row. Generated output, not reviewed; its presence is what `check:generated` demands. **Right.**
5. **Service** — `queryDataset` sets `drillScopes` on every rowful dataset answer on both faces (analytics-service.ts L3261-3268), from `resolved.compiled` (token-resolved, pre-binding); `resolveSelectionTokens` is now called once ahead of the executor (L3076) and exported from `dataset-executor.ts`. The package index (service-analytics `src/index.ts` L38-39) does not re-export it, so this is a package-internal export, not a public-surface change of `@objectstack/service-analytics`. The numbers are unchanged: the executor's own resolution over an already-resolved tree is the identity (the resolver allocates only when a placeholder was found, L147-157). **Right.**
6. **Adapter** — `ObjectStackAdapter.queryDataset` (data-objectstack index.ts L7303-7314, L7481-7489) adds `drillScopes?: AnalyticsResult['drillScopes']` to its return type and passes the map through when it is a non-array object. A public-surface widening of `@object-ui/data-objectstack`. **Right.** The REST door (`analytics-routes.ts` L269, `res.json(result)`) relays the result whole, and nothing else in `packages/` or `ui/packages/core` hand-picks the sidecars (grep of `dimensionFields` / `drillRawRows` / `drillRanges` on the head, non-test), so the adapter was the only drop point.
7. **Metadata protocol** — nothing an author writes changes: `DatasetSchema`, `DatasetMeasureSchema` and every authoring gate are untouched; the field is a response member only. `Metadata-protocol: none`. **Right.**
8. **Consumers** — `plugin-report` and `plugin-dashboard` are untouched, as the claim's ⛔ list and the card's order ("#30080 consumes it; the report / chart / table switch is a ui card the landing seat files") require. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/30526-dataset-measure-drill-scopes.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/service-analytics`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, each `patch`; body carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, bare and line-initial; the PR body carries the same two lines. Against AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3: "`none` takes `patch`" and "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`" — a published API answer widened with no authorable change is exactly that. Against `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`'s level axis (L907-935): a declared `none` must grade every introduced entry `patch` (all three are) and may move no `authorable-surface/` or `authorable-defaults/` baseline (the diff moves none; `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` is neither, L1605-1606); `yes (widening)` beside `none` is not one of the script's contradictions (`added` beside `no`, `narrowed` without `(narrowing)`). Every package whose published source the diff moves is named; `@object-ui/data-objectstack` is released through changesets (its CHANGELOG.md carries 18.3.0). `Check Changeset` on the head concluded success. **Clause-②: yes (widening) — matches what the diff publishes; level `patch` on all three is right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

Each flag from the os-dev-report (6664363611) and the PR body's Acceptance notes:

- **Shape 1, the not-null leg for a measure over a field** — holds. `dataset-compiler.ts` L870 writes `sql: m.field ?? '*'`, and every aggregate over a column skips an empty value, so the records a `count`/`sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max`/`count_distinct` over `field` read are exactly those where `field` holds a value; `{ field: { $null: false } }` is the declared operator (filter.zod.ts L1813). Without the leg, `count of total` would list rows the number never counted. Accepted.
- **Shape 2, both instants for a duration measure** — holds for the same reason; `valueLegs` (drill-scope.ts L95-104) emits one leg per instant. Accepted.
- **Shape 3, `{}` for a measure with nothing to add, absence meaning no drill** — holds, and it is the ruling's shape: #30080 (6631202970), "a tile whose dataset filter cannot be expressed as a list filter offers no click, rather than a list that does not match the number" needs one spelling for "no click", and this head gives absence that one meaning. The contract (analytics-service.ts L334-337) also states the map itself is `{}` when no selected measure has a scope; see ④ for the wire text.
- **Shape 4, tokens resolved once and shared** — holds. `resolveSelectionTokens` (dataset-executor.ts L128-158) resolves the dataset filter, every measure filter, the runtime filter and each `dateRange` against one `new Date()`; the scope reads the same trees the executor was handed. Moving the call outside the `try` is behaviour-preserving: the catch (analytics-service.ts L3090-3125) rethrows anything that is not a missing-source error, and a token refusal is never one, so its path is identical. Accepted.
- **Shape 5, a caller-minted measure gets a scope** — holds, and the mint cannot throw there: `datasetMeasureSource` (L4961-4973) reaches `mintCallerMeasures([m])` only for a name neither declared, derived nor a duration, and the executor minted that same name at L2888 inside the `try` before the scope block runs, so any refusal (`mintableMeasureKey`, L4847-4863; `inferMeasure`) already fired. Accepted.
- **Relationship paths** — nested form kept, dotted form left out: matches the ruling (left out means no click) and the record list's own refusal (`INVALID_FIELD`, pinned as CONTROL). A one-hop lowering is a later change, not owed here. Accepted.
- **Ledger growth (the `open_questions` entry)** — answered: the row `api/AnalyticsResultResponse` → `data.drillScopes.valueType.lazy` is accepted. It is the same `FilterConditionSchema` (`z.lazy` + comparand `superRefine`, filter.zod.ts L2332-2351) the ledger already admits at `api/AnalyticsQueryRequest where.lazy`, `api/DatasetSelection runtimeFilter.lazy`, `data/Query where.lazy` and `data/AnalyticsQuery where.lazy`; the closed list in `refinement-projection.ts` has no arm for a comparand check, and adding one would move the projection of every `FilterCondition` slot at once, which the ledger's own description calls a public-contract decision and not a refactor. Teaching the list is outside this card. The build names the site in `x-dropped-refinements`, and the totals move by exactly one schema and one site.
- **Found, not fixed: the engine refuses the nested-relation form inside a measure's own `filter` while `DatasetMeasureSchema` accepts it** — pre-existing, outside the hits and the claim's surface. Escalated to the seat: a card to file at landing (service-analytics / objectql, class c, with the dev's dedupe words).
- **Found, not fixed: the adapter also drops `drillRawTotals`** — pre-existing, zero ui readers. Escalated to the seat as a line on the ui card the landing seat files.
- **Branch name** `claude/project-thread-mg9ioh` — accepted by claim amendment 6662348690; no action.
- **Attribution link names the card thread** — platform-written; no action.
- **New `no-explicit-any` warnings in data-objectstack** — the file's existing `(data as any)` pattern, 0 errors, `Lint · ESLint` success; no action.
- **Deviation: the ablation sentence in the PR body** — the body on the PR already carries the corrected wording ("the bucket CONTROL and the contract-vs-wire pin included ... the two direct walk tests and the record-list CONTROL"); nothing left to do.
- **`check:test-typecheck` needs an 8 GB heap** — an environment note, not a verdict; CI's Type Check runs are the gate.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts` (L254-268)** against the ruling it implements and its first consumer. The shape is the one the card asked for ("the same vocabulary `drillRanges` uses"; a map from measure name to `FilterCondition`, the one filter vocabulary the dataset, the cube `where` and the record list all speak). I tried to break it on: a measure name that is an `Object.prototype` member (the service builds through a `Map` and `Object.fromEntries`, so it lands as an own property, and `z.record` reads own keys); a measure keyed by a cube-qualified spelling (the map is keyed by the selection's own spelling, which is how the answer's columns are keyed, executor L567, so the consumer's lookup is by the name it rendered); a filter whose values are `Date`s (`structuredClone` keeps them, `res.json` serialises them, the schema's comparand check reads ISO strings); a scope carrying a same-record `$field` comparand (objectql's filter path serves `{ $field }` comparands, `credential-evaluation-guard.ts` L42, L122, `having-filter.ts` L79). The declared vocabulary holds. The sidecar's conditions (set only when rows exist, absent on cube and draft-preview answers) match the four sidecars beside it and the contract's shared preamble (L223-229). The `$null: false` leg and the nested-relation form are both declared `FilterCondition` spellings. No must-fix.

**should-fix** — `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts:254-268`: the wire `describe` says "`{}` when none of these applies" of a measure's ENTRY, and "set on every dataset answer that has rows", but it never says the MAP itself may be `{}` (every selected measure left out, e.g. an answer whose only measures are derived). The contract text does (analytics-service.ts L334-337). A wire reader who must tell "absent" (not drillable at all) from "empty map" (present, no measure drillable) is the exact reader the ruling's "offers no click" depends on, and this text is the only one `gen:docs` publishes. One clause ("the map is `{}` when no selected measure has a scope") closes it; it can ride this PR or the ui card. Not a FAIL: the contract carries the sentence, and the parity pin keeps the two members typed identically.

**`packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts` (L223-229, L301-339)** against ADR-0021 D2 and its first consumer. D2's literal text is `drilldown` on a report, "click a cell → underlying records (free, dataset-backed)", and the Consequences bullet "a tile can ... expand to underlying records natively"; the contract on `main` already reads D2 as "the server answers the drill bounds" for the four existing sidecars, and this member is the fifth in that reading, not a new reading. The scenario it is accepted against (the showcase `paid_count` 2 against a bucket of 4) is pinned at the real-engine tier, both faces, with and without a widget filter, and composed exactly as the doc comment prescribes (bucket AND `runtimeFilter` AND scope). I tried to break the "left out means no drill" rule: a dotted key or `$field` anywhere in the tree is caught by the walk (drill-scope.ts L80-92), a non-object filter is caught (L129), a derived measure is caught before any filter is read (L126), and a measure neither declared nor minted is `undefined` from `datasetMeasureSource` and left out; a duration measure's dotted instant and a measure `field` that is a relationship path (`DatasetMeasureSchema` L410-413 allows one) are both dotted legs and both caught. The doc states the three parts, the `{}` entry, the `{}` map, the excluded cases and the composition, and the typing (`FilterCondition` from `data/filter.zod.js`, already imported) is the schema's own `z.ZodType` output, so the pin at analytics.test.ts L50 holds. No finding.

**should-fix** — `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-drill-scopes.test.ts:108-121` (coverage, outside the hits, read to judge the contract's "the record list serves it" claim for `$field`): the same-record `$field` reference is pinned only at the unit tier ("kept as written"); the real-engine tier pins no scope carrying `$field` against `engine.find`. The objectql read above says the list serves it, so no FAIL, but the claim the contract makes is one the test rig already has the means to measure.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · head `ba62840b7d742525f60c41a225359ea3887b3a72` · 2026-11-05T17:30Z
